channel.title: Gustavo Lobo — Blog
channel.description: Software Engineer focused on architecture, distributed systems, and performance.

item.title: Zero-Cost AI Gateway on the Edge
item.description: A production-style AI Gateway on Cloudflare Workers, Gemini free tier, and R2 — strict edge auth, native rate limiting, durable audit trail, and zero direct infrastructure cost.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: Centralized Observability with Prometheus, Loki, and Promtail
item.description: How to design a centralized observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, and Promtail — and the cardinality, retention, and failure-mode trade-offs that decide whether it scales.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: Observability with Prometheus and Micrometer
item.description: How to instrument JVM services with Micrometer and Prometheus — counters, timers, histograms with proper quantiles, and the cardinality discipline that decides whether the stack stays healthy.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: PostgreSQL Partitioning in Practice: When It Actually Pays Off
item.description: PostgreSQL declarative partitioning explained for production: range vs list vs hash, partition pruning vs constraint exclusion, indexing rules, and the queries that silently bypass pruning.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: Designing Systems That Scale Horizontally
item.description: Horizontal scalability is not about adding instances — it is about designing so adding instances does not change behavior. Statelessness, idempotency, single-writer patterns, and observability are the actual contract.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: Outbox Pattern with PostgreSQL in Practice
item.description: A production-grade implementation of the Outbox Pattern on PostgreSQL — schema, atomic write, polling vs LISTEN/NOTIFY, idempotent consumers, and the failure modes that make or break it.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: Designing Resilient Kafka Integrations
item.description: How to design Kafka integrations that survive broker outages, partial failures, and consumer rebalances — with concrete producer configs, the outbox pattern, and idempotent consumers.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: DDD in Practice: Modeling a Real Domain with Code
item.description: A practical walk-through of applying Domain-Driven Design — Aggregates, Value Objects, and Repositories — to make invalid states impossible by construction.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)

item.title: How Domain-Driven Design Changed How I Build Software
item.description: A personal account of why frameworks, clean layers, and tests stopped being enough — and how Domain-Driven Design reframed the work as understanding the domain first.
item.author: noreply@lobofoltran.dev (Gustavo Lobo)
